tool_input.command:
git add .gitignore && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(mission): ignore missions.jsonl.lock, the trace-log sibling lock file

Bugbot on PR #507: the E fix (locking a sibling missions.jsonl.lock
instead of the append-only data handle) introduced a new runtime
artifact that evaded every existing ignore rule. The mission-lock rule
(.punt-labs/ethos/missions/**/*.lock) only reaches locks NESTED under
missions/, not this file, which sits beside the tracked missions.jsonl
at the ethos root -- a sibling, not a descendant.

missions.jsonl is the tracked mission trace / audit artifact, so its
directory is one people deliberately commit -- without this rule the
lock file is untracked noise that the first `git add -A` commits, and
a stale .lock can then arrive via `git pull` on a machine that never
created it. Same class as the release-preflight failures on untracked
mission artifacts from earlier today.

Verified: touch .punt-labs/ethos/missions.jsonl.lock; git status
--porcelain shows nothing for it; git check-ignore -v confirms the
new rule matches.

ethos-cm2r
EOF
)"
